verdict.rationale: USCIS's Torch developer platform documents a Sandbox environment for sending test data. Production keys are issued only after passing a demo, which keeps testing separate from production. The documentation is brief, so the sandbox's scope and fidelity are not described. Missing for 10: details on sandbox data and behaviour (e.g. synthetic case and FOIA records, parity with production), explicit confirmation that it covers both the Case Status and FOIA APIs, and independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can test against a sandbox environment without touching production data

citations.quote: Gain Access and develop in our Sandbox environment to send test data.
Pass the demo and receive production keys to launch your application.
with developer accounts, API keys, and a sandbox.
